mapper.select: SELECT id AS deviceId, equipment_code AS equipmentCode, equipment_name AS deviceName, model, lab_id AS labId, lab_name AS labName, purchase_date AS purchaseDate, specification, manual_url AS manualUrl, status, status_text AS statusText, COALESCE(count, 0) AS count, COALESCE(count, 0) AS totalCount, residual_value AS residualValue FROM lab_equipment

SELECT e.id AS deviceId, e.equipment_code AS equipmentCode, e.equipment_name AS deviceName, e.model, e.lab_id AS labId, e.lab_name AS labName, e.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, e.specification, e.manual_url AS manualUrl, e.status, e.status_text AS statusText, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_equipment_asset a WHERE a.equipment_id = e.id AND a.status = 0) AS count, COALESCE(e.count, 0) AS totalCount, e.residual_value AS residualValue FROM lab_equipment e WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lab_equipment_asset a WHERE a.equipment_id = e.id AND a.status = 0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lab_equipment (equipment_code, equipment_name, model, lab_id, lab_name, purchase_date, specification, manual_url, status, status_text, count) VALUES (#{equipment_code}, #{equipment_name}, #{model}, #{lab_id}, #{lab_name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{purchase_date,jdbcType=DATE}, #{specification,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{manual_url,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{status,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0), CASE COALESCE(#{status,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0) WHEN 0 THEN '在库' WHEN 1 THEN '领用中' WHEN 2 THEN '故障待修' WHEN 3 THEN '已报废' ELSE '在库' END, COALESCE(#{count,jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1))

INSERT INTO lab_equipment (equipment_code, equipment_name, model, lab_id, lab_name, purchase_date, specification, manual_url, status, status_text, count) VALUES
(#{item.equipment_code}, #{item.equipment_name}, #{item.model}, #{item.lab_id}, #{item.lab_name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.purchase_date,jdbcType=DATE}, #{item.specification}, #{item.manual_url,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.status,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.status_text,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.count,jdbcType=INTEGER})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(count, 0) FROM lab_equipment WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE lab_equipment SET status = #{status}, status_text = CASE #{status} WHEN 0 THEN '在库' WHEN 1 THEN '领用中' WHEN 2 THEN '故障待修' WHEN 3 THEN '已报废' ELSE status_text END WHERE id = #{id}
